title: Documentation
subtitle: Build agent-ready systems from deterministic protocol contracts
description: Cardity Core documents the public protocol compiler API, MCP endpoint, CLI wrappers, and Agent OS manifest flow.

learningPath.title: Learning Path
learningPath.description: Recommended path for teams adopting Cardity as an agent protocol layer:
steps: Describe the system boundary as Cardity protocol source
Compile ABI, protocol JSON, and Agent OS manifest
Expose the protocol through API, MCP, CLI, or SDK
Let pmtsoul-agent map the manifest into tasks, tools, pages, and checks
Version ABI changes before agents regenerate production systems
